decisions.reason: The plug-in line builds on the established offer, has its own website page and costs little to maintain, so keeping the option open is cheap while demand evidence accumulates.

The building digital twin service is only mentioned on the website and its market value is still highly uncertain, but it is an emerging field where a low-cost option is worth holding for another year.
The authentication and delegation service is close to the core offer and overlaps with Product E, so it may later be merged into E, but one year is too early to abandon it.
The open GIS framework underpins the firm's component strategy and research and standards work, so it has high strategic option value at low marginal cost.
The identity service was actively announced at launch and integrates GIS applications seamlessly, which signals commitment and early positive prospects.
